title: Degree-zero canonical cohomology map evaluates to its f-map on sections.

from.place: Proof: degree-zero part of the canonical-map laws in the continuity argument, Tags 01F7 and 0A37.

statement: Let f:X→Y be a continuous map, F an abelian sheaf on Y and G an abelian sheaf on X. Let c be a family H^n(V,F′)→H^n(f⁻¹V,f⁻¹F′) [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback-data]. Assume only that c in degree zero on every coefficient sheaf at V=Y evaluates to the inverse-image adjunction unit. Given an f-map α:F→f_*G and x∈H^0(Y,F), the canonical map m(f,c,α,0) [def-weil-pbc-spectral-limit-cohomology-map] satisfies eval_X(m(x)) = α_Y(eval_Y(x)), with heterogeneous equality transporting along f⁻¹(Y)=X. Evaluation is the generator evaluation on Ext^0 of the sheafified free representable [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback-data]. No naturality or positive-degree compatibility of c is assumed.

source.place: Tags 01F7 and 01F8, degree-zero normalization in equation-functorial-derived and equation-functorial; Tag 0A37, lemma-colimit.

proof.text: Transport the terminal-open restriction along f⁻¹(Y)=X. After substituting equal opens, functoriality identifies this restriction with identity, hence evaluation is unchanged.

source.place: Tags 01F7 and 01F8, degree-zero normalization in equation-functorial-derived and equation-functorial; Tag 0A37, lemma-colimit.

proof.text: Naturality of generator evaluation moves the adjoint coefficient arrow β:f⁻¹F→G outside evaluation. The stated normalization then replaces the remaining pulled-back cohomology class by the unit applied to eval_Y(x).

source.place: Tags 01F7 and 01F8, degree-zero normalization in equation-functorial-derived and equation-functorial; Tag 0A37, lemma-colimit.

proof.text: The hom-equivalence of the inverse-image/pushforward adjunction identifies its unit followed by f_*β with α. Evaluate this identity on eval_Y(x) and compose the three heterogeneous equalities.
